name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
summary: Innkeeper Gryshka needs a courier to carry her thanks to Zargh at the Crossroads. She sends travelers to Doras the Wind Rider Master at Orgrimmar's skytower to arrange the flight back to the Barrens.

sections.title: A Courier's Reply
sections.body: Innkeeper Gryshka sends thanks to Zargh after a shipment of meat arrives safely from the Barrens hunting grounds. With no time to travel through Durotar herself, she trusts the established aerial courier network linking major Horde settlements to carry her letter back across the frontier.

sections.title: The Master of the Roost
sections.body: At the flight tower in the Valley of Strength, Doras oversees Orgrimmar's wind rider roost. The trained wyverns carry military messages and supplies between the capital and outposts such as the Crossroads, far faster than anyone traveling by foot or kodo cart.

faq.answer: Doras is Orgrimmar's primary wind rider master. He manages the city's trained wyverns and coordinates aerial travel to distant Horde hubs across central Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why is Innkeeper Gryshka sending this letter?
faq.answer: Gryshka is sending Zargh, the butcher at the Crossroads, a note of thanks for the meat supplies that arrived safely at her tavern in Orgrimmar.
Doras is atop the central flight tower above Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Wooden ramps inside the tower lead up to him.

faq.q: What happens after giving Gryshka's letter to Doras?
faq.answer: After you consult Doras, he prepares a wind rider to carry you back to the Barrens. You can deliver Gryshka's letter directly to Zargh at the Crossroads.
Zargh is an orc butcher at the Crossroads in the Barrens and a friend of Gryshka. He sent her a gift of choice cuts of Barrens meat.

faq.q: Why use wind riders instead of walking?
faq.answer: The overland route from Orgrimmar through Durotar and across the Southfury River into the Barrens is slow and perilous. The Horde uses tamed wind riders to swiftly carry scouts, orders, and couriers between settlements.

angles.text: The wind rider network links Orgrimmar to key regional garrisons, helping the young Horde move troops and supplies across Kalimdor's wilderness.
Since arriving on Kalimdor, orcs have forged a strong bond with its native wyverns. They rely on their agility and strength as flying mounts and beasts of burden.
